open_points.subject: start-up recovery of run spools
open_points.text: “first names to capability:store.remove_run_spool every ended run that does not keep its spool; then derives every run that has not ended”
open_points.question: When recovery derives a previously non-final run as succeeded, refused or cancelled, who removes its spool, given that the only spool-removal pass occurs before that derivation?
options: module:runs removes the spool immediately when recovery derives the final status
module:runs performs a second spool-removal pass after derivation and advancement
the spool remains until another restart
open_points.default_guess: module:runs removes the spool immediately when recovery derives the final status

open_points.subject: failure of start-up spool removal
open_points.text: “stopping the start with its reason on the first failure” and “except one that cannot be removed, which stays until a later start removes it”
open_points.question: If capability:store.remove_run_spool fails during start-up recovery, does the kernel stop the start or continue and open the surface with that spool still present?
options: stop the start and report the removal failure
continue start and retry removal on a later start
open_points.default_guess: stop the start and report the removal failure
